job_title: Senior Full-stack Software Engineer (Java, Quarkus, Angular)
description_text:
Why Join Exadel

We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.
What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

About the Client

Our customer is a leading financial institution with a strong focus on technology, innovation, and high-performance financial solutions. The company operates in a fast-paced environment where engineering excellence, scalability, resilience, and continuous innovation are key to delivering sophisticated products and services.

The technology team works on complex distributed systems and modern cloud architectures, providing an environment where engineers can work with cutting-edge technologies while solving challenging problems in the financial services industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and enhance backend applications using Java, focusing on performance, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
  • Build and maintain microservices with Quarkus, contributing to modern cloud-native architectures.
  • Develop and maintain frontend solutions using Angular, working across the application stack when required.
  • Design and implement event-driven solutions using AWS services such as SQS, SNS, Lambda, DynamoDB, and API Gateway.
  • Work with distributed architectures and contribute to building reliable and resilient systems.
  • Implement and evolve observability practices, including logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical decision-making, code reviews, and initiatives focused on engineering quality.
  • Contribute to automation, continuous improvement, and engineering productivity.

Software Engineer II

Location: Hyderabad
Experience: 3–5 Years

Role Overview

  • Looking for a Software Engineer II with strong Java/Spring Boot development experience.

  • Work on backend and frontend platforms supporting high-volume healthcare transactions.

  • Full-stack experience is a plus, with Angular preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain applications using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.

  • Work with MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.

  • Develop integrations with internal services.

  • Write unit and integration tests.

  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and production issue resolution.

  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and Product teams.

  • Follow clean coding practices and established design patterns.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

Must-Have Skills

  • 2–3 years of software development experience.

  • Strong Java + Spring Boot.

  • REST API development.

  • MySQL or other relational databases.

  • Unit & integration testing (JUnit or equivalent).

  • Basic AWS/cloud knowledge.

  • Agile/Scrum experience.

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Good to Have

  • Angular / TypeScript

  • MongoDB / Redis

  • AWS: S3, SQS, RDS, EC2

  • GitHub Actions / CI/CD

About Us

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.

At Epic, you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.

About the Role

The Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack owns features end-to-end across Epic's web application -- Angular front-end, PHP/Symfony and Go services, MySQL -- and helps raise the engineering bar for the team. We hire for engineering strength over experience with any specific stack; strong engineers ramp quickly on ours.

This is a fully remote, India-based role, requiring close collaboration with a global engineering team that has members in the US, India and China.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship features end-to-end across the full stack, from spec to production.
  • Make sound decisions on architecture, data modeling, and API design; document trade-offs and align stakeholders.
  • Drive code quality through code review and testing across front-end and back-end.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code review and pairing.
  • Lead technical design reviews, RFCs, and architecture discussions.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery,
